build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Revision history: v1 (commit b3cd8b2) was a night storefront exterior with only a celeste accent in the text layer -- client asked for a real Guatemalan symbol and a scene that reads as a barbershop. v2 (commit ea3af4a) fixed both with a moody night-lit barbershop interior (classic barber chair, mirror, styling station with visible tools) plus a Guatemalan flag hanging on the wall as the one full-color element over an otherwise black-and-white duotone photo. v3 (commit 55ba4fb): client found v2 'aburrido' and 'oscuro', so backgrounds were regenerated in full natural color with bright daylight and colorful papel picado paper bunting strung across the ceiling for a festive feel -- same barber chair, mirror, styling-station tools, and Guatemalan flag as v2. v4 (this revision): client asked to remove the hanging decorations and show the Guatemalan flag 'como es' (accurately) and larger/more prominent. Backgrounds regenerated again with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (feed at aspect-ratio 3:4 / resolution 2K, story at 9:16 / 2K): same bright, full-color daylight barbershop interior with the classic barber chair, mirror, and styling-station tools, but with all papel picado/bunting removed, and the Guatemalan flag now mounted on a wooden pole and rendered large and dominant in the frame, with the accurate national coat of arms (quetzal bird, scroll, crossed rifles and swords, laurel wreath) centered in the white band -- not just a plain tricolor. design-system.md's duotone/gold-key-light photography rule remains deliberately set aside for this one commemorative piece (as established in v3), same spirit as the color exceptions precedented in mundial-bandera-argentina/ and dia-partido-camiseta/, just extended to the full frame instead of one element. All prior background versions are kept for reference under raw/: bg-v1-exterior*.png, bg-v2-night-barbershop*.png, bg-v3-papel-picado*.png. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html), unchanged since v2: celeste (#4997D0) pill, headline highlight word, and a thin celeste/bone/celeste flag-rule divider under the headline, echoing the flag's own colors. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). This is a purely commemorative post (no hours, no price, no booking CTA) -- distinct from the operational posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ post about special hours on the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: Orgullosamente / Guatemaltecos
